Open Office presentation starter artwork
Copyright (c) 2026 Open Office contributors

Original artwork created for Open Office. No third-party imagery, logos or fonts
are included. cover.png and closing.png are raster renderings of the adjacent
SVG sources; content-mark.svg is also represented by editable vector shapes in
the presentation model.
